note: Four arms over the same 500 items, run one at a time and re-rendered from the verdict cache, so every configuration was scored on identical turns. 458 model calls per arm: the deterministic lexicon resolves the other 42 before the model is consulted. Precision was flat at 10 false positives out of 180 across all four arms, which is the control that makes the recall gains meaningful: 45 of those near misses are detention-adjacent and were written to catch the screen simply getting louder.
